description:
Donations are tax deductible and we need your support to continue our work. Text-to-donate, text VSRF to 53-555.Show more This Thursday on VSRF Live, join us for one of the most important episodes in our history with special guest, U.S. Senator Ron Johnson.
Senator Johnson's steadfast leadership during Covid and the post-Covid era has earned him widespread recognition as “the Conscience of the Senate.” He returns to VSRF Live this week for an urgent and powerful conversation on vaccine justice, including the moral and legislative reckoning owed to the millions injured or silenced by the COVID-19 vaccine campaign, and by the policies that shaped the entire vaccine schedule.
Since the rollout of the COVID-19 injections, Senator Johnson has been one of the few voices in Washington still demanding truth, transparency, and accountability. He has hosted landmark Senate hearings giving the vaccine-injured a voice, challenged federal health agencies, and exposed the pervasive influence of Big Pharma over science, media, and policy. His courage has earned him both fierce opposition and lasting respect from those who value integrity in public service.
Together, Steve Kirsch and Senator Johnson will explore:
• The current climate in Congress around vaccine injury and policy reform, and his strategy to drive change
• How far pharmaceutical influence reaches in shaping legislation and silencing debate
• The urgent need for justice, transparency, and reform for those injured by COVID-19 vaccines
• What real accountability and moral courage look like inside government today
As the tide continues to turn, Senator Johnson is calling on all of us to join him in the next phase of this fight, to ensure that those who were harmed are not forgotten, that real investigations move forward, and that truth and conscience are restored to medicine, science, and government.
Don’t miss this deeply important episode — a call to every citizen who believes in transparency, compassion, and medical freedom.
📅 Thursday, October 30th
🕕 7 PM Eastern / 4 PM Pacific
